The first two PRs to implement this feature (of a planned 3) are open for reviews:
- https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15252
- https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15271

The major remaining chunk after those is displaying the diff-of-diff with the "changed" commits.  The core challenge of computing the diff is complete in the [web-range-diff-w-patch](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/compare/forgejo...mfenniak:web-range-diff-w-patch) branch; the UI requires a few passes of refinement, and integration tests are required, but it should be complete in a few days.

Out-of-scope for the initial implementation would be any interactivity with the diff, such as creating review comments from it.
